cards.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM modele WHERE membership_id IS NULL;
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM modele WHERE membership_id IS NULL;

cards.title: Diagnose Categorical Drift in smsc_routing_rule.pattern
cards.rationale: The column smsc_routing_rule.pattern shows categorical drift, with two similar but distinct patterns (` ^216\d{8}$` and `^216\d{8}$`). This diagnostic query helps to identify the distribution of these patterns, which may indicate data inconsistency or a need for standardization.
cards.sql: SELECT pattern, COUNT(*) AS count, (COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM smsc_routing_rule)) * 100 AS percentage FROM smsc_routing_rule GROUP BY pattern ORDER BY count DESC;
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pattern) FROM smsc_routing_rule WHERE pattern IN (' ^216\d{8}$', '^216\d{8}$');

cards.title: Diagnose Low Cardinality in user_contact_tags.tag_id
cards.rationale: The column user_contact_tags.tag_id has low cardinality (7 distinct values for 20051 rows). This diagnostic query helps to understand the distribution of values and assess if an index is beneficial or if the column could be normalized further.
cards.sql: SELECT tag_id, COUNT(*) AS count, (COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_contact_tags)) * 100 AS percentage FROM user_contact_tags GROUP BY tag_id ORDER BY count DESC;
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) FROM user_contact_tags;
